text:
deploy-bot: initiating v2 gradual roll for slice group C at 09:58 UTC. Target ramp: 5% -> 15% over 20m. Pinlist excludes: enterprise-paid.csv and tenant-exclude.csv.

mike: heads up — rolling change includes header normalization + streaming chunk reassembler. any known non-backwards issues?

tara: header normalization should be safe but mobile SDK 1.4.1 had an edge-case where it lowercased headers twice, causing a blank 'content-type' on some requests. fixed in SDK PR #483.

sanjay: observed transient 502s in staging for tenant 'velox' when sequence lengths > 8k tokens (stream boundary reassembly). No repro on shorter contexts.

ops-jen: alert from deploy monitor: velox slice 7 spike to 1.3% 5xx at 10:08 UTC, automated pause triggered.

deploy-bot: rollout paused at operator request. Traffic for affected slices reverted to v1.

mike: can we pin velox to v1 quickly? we don't want tenant-facing errors.

rebecca: yes, apply temporary pin and add to incident notes. ops runbook suggests pin via deploy API.

sanjay: command: curl -s -X POST https://deploy.internal/pin -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${OP_TOKEN}' -d '{"tenant":"velox","route":"/api","version":"v1","reason":"v2 streaming edge 5xx","expires":"2026-03-28T00:00:00Z"}'

ops-jen: pin applied, deploy-bot picked up pin in 30s. Telemetry backfill shows velox 5xx down to 0.04% after 3m.

rebecca: ops note: create hotfix branch to backport streaming delimiter fix only, avoid touching header normalization for now. SDK team to cut 1.4.2 with patch.

mike: release notes: add under "Known compatibility changes": header name normalization; SDK 1.4.2 required for some mobile clients; how to pin to v1 for tenants experiencing issues.

ops-jen: escalation criteria: if pinned tenants account for >7% of canary traffic or 3 tenants with >0.5% 5xx each -> schedule rollback window.

deploy-bot: monitoring status: slices resumed for unaffected tenants. Canary group health OK.

tara: if hotfix ready in 45m, we can re-run a narrow canary limited to long-context tenants only. need product signoff for narrow slice.

mike: product alerted, will check impact. I'll publish release note draft mentioning pin instructions and the emergency rollback criteria.

rebecca: thanks everyone. incident ticket open: INC-2026-457. Assigning to oncall.

ops-jen: assigning now to oncall and adding postmortem placeholder.

rebecca: :white_check_mark:
